audience: people in the United States gathering their own papers for a divorce or custody matter, a problem at work, a VA disability claim, a parent's estate or a child's IEP; many are stressed and reading on a phone
voice: plain, calm and factual; short sentences; second person. Short sentences, not short answers: the answer under the H1 and every FAQ answer each run 40 to 60 words. Educational only and never legal advice: never tell the reader what to file, whether to sue, or how a case will turn out; never say court-ready, admissible, proves, best or win your case; never rank or recommend lawyers. VA: never prepare, file, rate or judge a claim; say KeepMyProof is not affiliated with the VA and point to free VA-accredited representatives on VA.gov. Keep only papers you are allowed to have; never suggest recording people secretly or copying an employer's systems or a spouse's accounts. Vault and photo pages: KeepMyProof is a private vault for photos and documents, a normal locked app on the home screen; never say it is hidden from the phone, disguised, undetectable, or that deleted photos cannot be recovered; the iPhone-only offer is "Remove the original from Photos?" (the phone asks to confirm; Recently Deleted keeps it 30 days); on Android the reader deletes the original in Google Photos (the app never deletes it). Papers stay encrypted on this one phone: never say they sync, open on any other device or are kept in iCloud or Google Drive; the only copy elsewhere is an encrypted backup file the reader chooses to save. Recording law: never say a state bans recording a conversation you are part of unless that state requires everyone's consent; say recording a conversation you are not part of, or getting into someone else's phone or accounts, can be a crime, and to ask a lawyer before relying on a recording. VA: never tell the reader which conditions or which claim type to file; point to a free VA-accredited representative. Link the vault hub https://keepmyproof.com/vault and the disclaimer https://keepmyproof.com/disclaimer.
